recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If the project still wants Resource(OperationOutcome) to render more clearly in tables or diagrams, handle that as the separate tooling/display work noted by FHIR-I rather than editing generated Bundle diagram artifacts here.
issue_request: FHIR-46484 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested that Bundle.issues short display, definition, and comments state that the element is an OperationOutcome resource, since FHIR-32011 intended OperationOutcome even though the display showed Resource.
initial_application: FHIR-32011 introduced Bundle.issues in R5 through commits 88c3289f77 and 66ccc36aa4 using ElementDefinition.type code Resource plus profile http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/OperationOutcome. FHIR-46484 was later applied by ce45edd65298ee221dbcee7e6a0319d114b04eef, which added the OperationOutcome profile line and revised Bundle.issues short, definition, and comment text to name OperationOutcome explicitly.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml current build-scope source. FHIR-I minutes on 2024-07-29 confirm the approved scope: add OperationOutcome wording to the short/description and leave restricted-Resource display as separate tooling work. Zulip committers discussion for FHIR-32011 explains why Resource plus an OperationOutcome profile was used instead of type code OperationOutcome. The checked-in bundle.svg still displays Resource, but it is a generated diagram artifact and not the authoritative source for this reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current Bundle StructureDefinition already has short value 'OperationOutcome with issues about the Bundle', a definition beginning 'An OperationOutcome...', a whole-Bundle usage comment, and a Resource type profiled to OperationOutcome.
